title: 極地軌道：熱力学的な葬送
author: 鷹野 シン

prediction.question: カイルが手にした「熱い遺物」は、次に何を呼び起こすか？
options: 治安維持ドローンの集団襲撃
遺物から投影される偽の記憶
デバイスの暴走による周囲の融解

en.title: Polar Orbit: A Thermodynamic Requiem
en.premise: In a managed society where every joule of energy is strictly controlled and allocated, 'emotions' and 'art' are purged as thermodynamic waste. Kyle, a technology recovery officer, discovers a 'warm relic'—an object that logically should not exist—within the ruins of an ancient underground orbit. It is a singularity of physics that humanity once took pride in, and a ticking bomb capable of shattering the foundations of their controlled world. Kyle resolves to board the final train, destined for decommissioning, as it carries him toward the boundaries of the closed city.

zh.title: 极地轨道：热力学的葬送
zh.premise: 在一个所有能量都被统一管理与分配的管控社会中，“感情”与“艺术”被视为热力学上的浪费，而遭到严苛的排除。技术回收官凯尔在废墟般的旧时代地下轨道中，发现了一件在逻辑上不应存在的“带有热量的遗物”。那曾是人类引以为傲的物理学奇点，同时也是足以撼动管控社会根基的炸弹。凯尔决定登上那列已被决定停止运行的最终列车，前往封闭城市的边界。
